title: Changeset
description: Describes what was changed in an implementation and why. Produced by lambda, consumed by delta and axiom.

summary.description: One sentence describing what changed. Under 200 characters.

files_changed.description: Paths of files added, modified, or deleted

tests_added.description: Paths of test files added or modified

acceptance_criteria_met.description: IDs from spec@1.acceptance_criteria that this changeset satisfies

criteria_evidence.description: Per-criterion evidence trail: exactly where each acceptance_criteria_met ID is tested and implemented. When sourced from implementer's own TDD cycle, test_line and implementation_line are exact. When reconstructed from a diff with no lambda run behind it, file-level entries without line numbers are acceptable rather than fabricating precision that was never observed. A criterion may have more than one entry when it is proven in more than one place.

breaking_changes.description: Public API or behavior changes that break existing callers

commits.description: Git SHAs of commits in this changeset

linked_requirement.description: ID of the requirement@1 this change ultimately traces back to. Propagated from spec@1.linked_requirement via plan@1.linked_requirement when available.
